queries.legacy_json: WITH gate AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM banned_ips WHERE ip=$1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>now())) AS banned) SELECT banned,CASE WHEN banned THEN NULL::json ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(item),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT p.id,p.title,p.excerpt,p.created_at,COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id=p.id WHERE p.published=true GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC) item) END FROM gate
queries.current_rows: WITH gate AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM banned_ips WHERE ip=$1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>now())) AS banned) SELECT gate.banned,item.id,item.title,item.excerpt,to_json(item.created_at),item.comment_count FROM gate LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.id,p.title,p.excerpt,p.created_at,COUNT(c.post_id) AS comment_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id=p.id WHERE p.published=true AND NOT gate.banned GROUP BY p.id) item ON true ORDER BY item.created_at DESC
queries.covering_rows: WITH gate AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM banned_ips WHERE ip=$1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>now())) AS banned) SELECT gate.banned,item.id,item.title,item.excerpt,to_json(item.created_at),item.comment_count FROM gate LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.id,p.title,p.excerpt,p.created_at,COUNT(c.post_id) AS comment_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id=p.id WHERE p.published=true GROUP BY p.id LIMIT CASE WHEN gate.banned THEN 0 ELSE NULL END) item ON true ORDER BY item.created_at DESC

method: One psql session per fixture, prepared statements, rotating query order, 3 warmups and 12 measured repetitions, EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS TIMING OFF; SQL execution time only, not DB CPU or HTTP throughput.
